entries.title: Psalms 123:1
segments: When affliction leads us to seek help and comfort from God, it has the effect for which it is sent.

entries.title: Psalms 123:2
segments:
Unto the hand of their masters--unto the hand of her mistress; because it is the hand upon which they are dependent; the hand which supplies, governs, and protects them. 
 
Since all our trials come upon us by God's appointment for our profit, we should look to him alone for deliverance, and use no means to this end but such as are consistent with his revealed will.

entries.title: Psalms 123:4
segments: "The Lord seeth not as man seeth."  They whom he most loves and honors are very often the objects of scorn and derision to the proud and luxurious.
